request_state.conjecture: Beal conjecture: A^x + B^y = C^z with x,y,z >= 3 and gcd(gcd(A,B),C) = 1 has no positive integer solutions. Target discipline: strictly x,y,z >= 3; no exponent 2; no relabelling GRH or heuristics as unconditional.

candidate.claim: MOTIVIC OBSTRUCTION SYNTHESIS ACROSS ARBITRARY SIGNATURES: Formal taxonomy of arithmetic geometry obstructions preventing an unconditional proof of Beal for general (p, q, r).
candidate.text: For general triples (p, q, r), Darmon Frey representations yield hyperelliptic curves of genus g = (r-1)/2. For g >= 2, modularity of abelian varieties of GL2-type is open, and Serre uniformity is unproved.

statement_fidelity.instructions: Does this candidate faithfully respect the strict Beal conjecture formulation (all exponents >= 3, positive integers, gcd=1) without introducing exponent-2 blindness or relaxing hypotheses?

criteria.true: strictly faithful to the original conjecture formulation
criteria.false: relaxes hypotheses or introduces exponent-2 vulnerability
